_comment: sunnyconf schema overrides — applied on top of the SDUI-derived schema (registry + settings_ui.json). Use for: keys not (yet) in settings_ui.json, offroad_only / requires_restart, title/description fixes, hiding internal keys, or group title/order. Per-param keys: title, description, type, options ([[value,label]]), min, max, step, unit, default, offroad_only, requires_restart, hidden, group, section. The 'groups' map sets per-group title/order.
